questions.qtext: In pretensioned prestressed concrete beam which of the following losses is/are not considered?

options.text: Loss due to relaxation of steel

questions.solution:
(b, d)
In prestressed pretensioned member, loss of prestress is only due to shrinkage, creep, relaxation of steel, elastic shortening of concrete.
Hence, the correct options are (b) and (d).
